[[The Greater Darkness]] is a powerful [[Demon]] and one of the four [[Lords of Anguish]] leading [[Mallyx the Unyielding]]'s forces within [[Ravenheart Gloom]]. When it and both of [[the Darkness]]es which accompany it are slain, they will [[spawn]] a group of five more of The Darknesses. Each one of those five will spawn five [[Earth Tormentor]]s when they are slain.

*When slain, the enemies that spawn after it may not necessarily appear immediately. If they do not, move closer to where the Greater Darkness was defeated.
